get.summary:
FOr batch retrieval of Events based on a query.
    <remarks>
    1. This endpoint is Public
1. This endpoint is Non-Idempotent
    </remarks>

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description:
Inclusive start of the requested date range as an ISO-8601 instant with offset.
An event matches when its end (or start, when no end is set) is on or after this instant.
Omit for an open-ended start.

parameters.name: EndDate
parameters.description:
Inclusive end of the requested date range as an ISO-8601 instant with offset.
An event matches when its start is on or before this instant.
Omit for an open-ended end.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the event name.

parameters.name: Organizer
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the organizer.

parameters.name: City
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the venue city.

parameters.name: Price.Value
parameters.description: Maximum price value used by the price filter.

parameters.name: Price.Currency
parameters.description: Currency associated with the price filter value.

parameters.name: VenueName
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the venue name.

parameters.name: GenresNames
parameters.description: Restricts results to events linked to at least one of the supplied genre names.

parameters.name: Artist
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on any linked artist name.

parameters.name: Search
parameters.description:
Case-insensitive OR search across the event name, venue name and any linked artist name.
This filter is combined with all other filters using AND.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: One-based page number. Values below 1 are clamped to 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page. Values outside 1-100 are clamped into that range. Defaults to 10.
